---
pagetitle: "Как се събират 250 кредита"
lang: bg
format:
  revealjs:
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    margin: 0.04
    center: false
    slide-number: c/t
    transition: fade
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        :root {
          --r-main-font: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
          --r-heading-font: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
          --r-main-font-size: 26px;
          --r-main-color: #0b0b0b;
          --r-heading-color: #0b0b0b;
          --r-heading-text-transform: none;
          --r-heading-font-weight: 650;
          --r-heading-letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }
        .reveal, .reveal h1, .reveal h2, .reveal h3, .reveal p, .reveal li { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; }
        .reveal .slides section { text-align: left; }
        .reveal h1, .reveal h2, .reveal h3 { color: #0b0b0b; text-transform: none; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
        .reveal h1 { font-size: 76px; line-height: 1.05; margin: 0 0 18px; }
        .reveal h2 { font-size: 40px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
        .reveal h2 .h-sub { font-weight: 400; color: #52514e; font-size: 0.7em; margin-left: 10px; }
        .reveal .kicker { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
          color: #898781; margin: 0 0 6px; }
        .reveal .sub { font-size: 19px; color: #52514e; margin: 0 0 12px; }
        .reveal svg.credit-map { display: block; width: 100%; height: 590px; }
        .reveal svg.year-bars { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; margin: 14px 0 18px; }
        .reveal .cards { display: grid; gap: 16px; align-items: start; }
        .reveal .cards.cols-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); margin-top: 26px; }
        .reveal .cards.cols-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
        .reveal .cards.cols-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
        .reveal .card { background: var(--w); border-top: 6px solid var(--c); border-radius: 8px;
          padding: 14px 18px 12px; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.35; color: #0b0b0b; }
        .reveal .card h3 { font-size: 22px; margin: 0 0 2px; line-height: 1.2; }
        .reveal .card .num { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #52514e; margin: 0 0 8px; }
        .reveal .card p { margin: 0 0 6px; }
        .reveal .card p.sem { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase;
          color: #898781; margin: 8px 0 2px; }
        .reveal .card p.note { font-size: 16px; color: #52514e; }
        .reveal .card ul { margin: 0 0 4px 1.1em; padding: 0; }
        .reveal .card li { margin: 2px 0; }
        .reveal .card .code { font-size: 14px; color: #898781; white-space: nowrap; }
        .reveal .rules-slide .card { font-size: 21px; padding: 18px 22px 16px; }
        .reveal .cover { padding-top: 120px; }
        .reveal .cover .lead { font-size: 30px; color: #52514e; margin: 0 0 28px; }
        .reveal .cover .swatches { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin: 0 0 90px; }
        .reveal .cover .swatches span { width: 54px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; }
        .reveal .cover .source { font-size: 15px; color: #898781; max-width: 900px; }
        </style>
---

<!-- Програмна схема – визуализация (Quarto revealjs). Всеки слайд е HTML блок между линиите ---.
     Слайдовете могат да се копират в друга .qmd презентация заедно с include-in-header блока горе. -->

```{=html}
<div class="cover">
  <p class="kicker">Бакалавърска програма „Управление на бизнеса и предприемачество“ · редовно обучение</p>
  <h1>Как се събират<br>250 кредита</h1>
  <p class="lead">Програмната схема година по година</p>
  <div class="swatches"><span style="background:#256abf"></span><span style="background:#eda100"></span><span style="background:#eb6834"></span><span style="background:#1baf7a"></span><span style="background:#3d3c38"></span></div>
  <p class="source">Източник: Програмна схема – випуск 2025/2026 (Приложение 3 към Наредбата за учебния процес
  на НБУ); курсове по електронния каталог 2026/2027.</p>
</div>
```
